data.name: Dark Earth
data.detailed_description:
Re-release

Originally released in 1997, Dark Earth is a cinematic real-time action-adventure from French studio Kalisto Entertainment, set in a sunless, post-apocalyptic world. Praised in its day for its richly imagined setting and atmosphere, and named one of 1997's best adventures, it's now available digitally for the first time.

Re-release is currently in development. Dark Earth is being updated to run smoothly on modern systems, with the complete list of enhancements to be shared closer to the release date.


About the Game

ONE RAY OF HOPE AGAINST A POISONOUS AND TREACHEROUS DARKNESS

Earth is a dark world. Dust and debris chokes the air and your flesh is being attacked by a deadly virus. Poisonous clouds drift across the black sky; animal and plant life has all but died out. In this unforgiving landscape you must uncover a secret that will help restore the one thing that can save all humanity – Light! 

You'll discover grisly murder plots through real-time adventure and fight treacherous, greedy and bizarre characters in fully-controlled combat. But beware! If you're not careful, foes will destroy the city and your life as you ponder your next move.

FEATURES

  • Jump into a real-time graphic adventure game set in a robust, active and visually-stunning world

  • Experience real-time combat and character reactions, matched by intense time pressure to solve the game

  • Immerse yourself in 25 minutes of video scenes, 100 unique separately-modelled characters and 260 pre-rendered camera views

  • Easy to control character movement, combat, conversations and inventory management

data.short_description: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.
